payload.originalOpinion: The platform exhibits a strong content generation capability but suffers from a critical lack of new user acquisition and community engagement, as evidenced by zero new users and zero comments in the last 7 days. The absence of recent view tracking further hinders the ability to diagnose content performance and user behavior. While a mobile shell is present, the core UX/UI needs significant attention to drive growth and interaction.
